title: SUSTEAS Rotary Cheese Grater with Handle - Vegetable Shredder with 5 Well-designed Blades & Strong Suction Base,Round Mandoline Slicer & Food Chopper for Kitchen,with Blade Storage Box(Retro Green)
description:
About this item
Designed for Your Kitchen: This hand crank cheese grater is a functional and aesthetically pleasing kitchen essential, with components made of 18/10 stainless steel blades and food-grade materials that are BPA-avoiding materials for peace of mind. As the representative color of nature, green is brought to your home by SUSTEAS, which can add a touch of natural beauty to your kitchen and enjoy healthy food easily
Makes Shredding A Breeze: This latest multi-purpose food grater and shredder chops ingredients up to 12 times faster than other vegetable grater, reducing prep time for greater convenience and efficiency. Equipped with 5 replaceable blades, no need for any cutting skills, just turn the handle a few times, whether sliced or shredded, thick shredded, even wavy, it can be easily handled, quickly prepare food, such as cheese, potatoes, zucchini , Carrot, Cucumber, Chocolate

Fingers and palms do not touch the blades, eliminating dangerous operation of the traditional cheese shredder. In addition, the mandoline slicer has a sloping curve that allows the grated ingredients to fall smoothly without clogging
Easy to Clean And Store: All parts of our cheese grater with handle can be easily disassembled and assembled, no more troubles of cleaning and scrubbing, the most important thing is that the blade can be completely disassembled, completely avoiding finger damage when cleaning harm. Its compact size lets you store it almost anywhere, and the included blade storage case keeps your countertop clean and tidy. Dishwasher safe (except base)
Kitchenware Experts at Your Side: We have tailored the packaging to enhance the appeal of the cheese shredder rotary for special occasions, complemented by a comprehensive guide that ensures even the first-time user can operate it with ease. Our unwavering dedication to excellence ensures that we are always ready to address any concerns, fostering trust in the enduring quality and performance of our products
